title: Soft backend: add CKM_EDDSA (Ed25519)
description: wolfCrypt has wc_ed25519_sign_msg and wc_ed25519_verify_msg but wolfP11 does not expose CKM_EDDSA. Implement Ed25519 sign and verify in wp11_backend_soft.c, add CKM_EDDSA to g_mechs[], add CKK_EC_EDWARDS key type support, and add the mechanism info case to C_GetMechanismInfo.
